name: board
description: The owner's Project board: issues, fields and milestones synced from the plan, and the PLAN-BOARD rule (docs/design/board.md).

messages.ciUsage: usage: aidlc ci wait, with ci.wait (seconds) and github.repo in the profile
messages.ciNotPushed: push {{base}} first: aidlc push; CI runs on the pushed base
messages.planBoard: {{unit}} has no {{path}}, which the board shows as {{field}}: add {{example}}{{mapping}}
messages.planBoardOption: {{unit}}'s {{path}} gives {{field}} {{value}}, which the board lacks (it has {{options}}): plan one of those, or the owner adds the option on the Project
messages.boardOff: no github section in the profile: the board is off
messages.boardProject: github.project {{project}} is not orgs/<owner>/projects/<n> or users/<owner>/projects/<n>
messages.boardBehind: the board is behind: aidlc sync
messages.boardNoOptions: sync wrote nothing: the Project lacks {{#each missing}}{{this}}; {{/each}}→ add the option on the Project, or plan a value it has, then run aidlc sync
messages.boardItemHidden: #{{number}} is on the Project but not listed, also after waiting (an archived item?) → restore it or remove it on the Project, then run aidlc sync
messages.boardShort: GitHub listed {{got}} of the repository's {{count}} issues, also after waiting → sync created nothing; run aidlc sync again later
messages.boardFailed: warning: sync failed, run aidlc sync: {{error}}

board.itemExists: Content already exists in this project

queries.project: query($login: String!, $number: Int!, $cursor: String) { {{owner}}(login: $login) { projectV2(number: $number) { id fields(first: 50) { nodes { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { id name dataType } ... on ProjectV2SingleSelectField { options { id name } } } } items(first: 100, after: $cursor) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id content { ... on Issue { number repository { nameWithOwner } } } fieldValues(first: 30) { nodes { ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldSingleSelectValue { name field { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { name } } } ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldNumberValue { number field { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { name } } } ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldDateValue { date field { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { name } } } ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldTextValue { text field { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { name } } } } } } } } } }
queries.issueCount: query($owner: String!, $name: String!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { issues { totalCount } } }
queries.addItem: mutation($project: ID!, $content: ID!) { addProjectV2ItemById(input: { projectId: $project, contentId: $content }) { item { id } } }
queries.setField: mutation($project: ID!, $item: ID!, $field: ID!, $value: ProjectV2FieldValue!) { updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue(input: { projectId: $project, itemId: $item, fieldId: $field, value: $value }) { projectV2Item { id } } }

PLAN-BOARD.fix: add the planned value to the unit's frontmatter, as the example shows

commands.name: sync
commands.does: project intents and units onto GitHub issues and a Project

commands.name: ci
commands.does: wait for the pushed base's CI runs and record the result
